card.name: Recurring intervals and repeat timing
card.fires_on: Words that set how often something recurs, such as intervals, periodically, frequently, regular, or times per week. Also the end of dialysis (dial-ysis) when a dose follows each session.

modes.label: Frequency words
modes.description: Words that state how often an action repeats, such as intervals, times, frequently, or regular.
modes.example: at<< intervals>> of no less than 2 weeks.

modes.label: Dialysis session
modes.description: The final part of dialysis when a dose is given with or after each session.
modes.example: should be given 25 mg or 50 mg after each dial<<ysis>>; this should be done under hospital supervision

modes.label: Every N units
modes.description: The number in an every-N-weeks schedule.
modes.example: Increase the daily dose every <<2>> weeks by increments of 20 mg

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about repetition, order and timing, such as 'repeatedly', 'sequence' and 'when'.
card.plain: It lights up on words that say how often or how regularly something is repeated, including doses after each dialysis session.
